title: What is a Download Number?
summary: What a Download Number is and how to use it to get a schematic or world file.

body.content: A Download Number, or DN, is the number used to find the files for a video. It is usually provided in the video's description.

body.text: DNs identify TheySix farm downloads. A farm built from another creator's video may not have a TheySix DN.

items.content: Copy the DN from the description of the video.
Use the command `/dn [number]`. For example, use `/dn 467`.
The bot will show the files connected to that DN.

body.content: If you are filling out a support form for a specific farm, enter the number as `/dn input:<number>` when the form asks for it. Do not upload the video file as the DN.
